rubrics.justification: Mostly consistent with the provided 2BB grade, correctly describing a loose ICM and sparse/irregular TE, but it shows some uncertainty and a possible inconsistency by calling the embryo non-expanding/early-to-full while the lab data specify a stage 2 full blastocyst.

Integrates key factors well, including young age, endometrial thickness, prior IVF failures, miscarriage/ectopic history, BMI, and semen parameters, though it somewhat overinterprets FSH and lacks deeper discussion of the unspecified diagnosis/protocol.

Reasoning is structured and generally logical, with conclusions tied to embryo morphology and patient history; the main weakness is that the implantation estimate may be somewhat optimistic for an untested 2BB embryo with repeated prior failures.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice guidelines, including single embryo transfer at age 29, luteal support, early ectopic surveillance, and uterine reassessment after failure; minor deviations include somewhat casual discussion of PGT-A and probability framing.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, monitoring, uterine evaluation, sperm DNA fragmentation consideration, and cycle review, though recommendations are not highly individualized beyond standard IVF management.
